newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIU AND HANSA AGAIN LEAD BOURSE HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: HOIU AND HANSA AGAIN LEAD BOURSE HIGHER.

text.p: * Total morning trade 31.2 million kroons.
* Talse index up 1.46 percent to 361.79.
* Hoiupank was leading, to be higher at
221.75/223.75 kroons vs 221.45 kroons on 13.1 million kroons.
* Hansapank was again trading above the 200 kroons
level at 201.50/202.50 kroons vs 196.10 kroons with 10.1 million
kroons traded.
Strong gains in Hoiupank and
Hansapank kept the bourse moving upwards in Friday early trade
but activity was expected to slow in the afternoon ahead of the
weekend, dealers said.
"There does not seem to be many sellers about and low
liquidity may be a problem here, but the buying interest
remains," one dealer said.
"Interest may start to wane now as people get ready for the
weekend," he added.
Hoiupank registered trade of 13.3 million kroons to be
higher at a spread of 222/224.50 kroons versus 221.45 kroons.
"Hoiupank has still to release its revised profit forecast
for 1997 and this is building up interest in the stock," another
dealer said.
Hansapank turned over 10.6 million kroons to be at a spread
of 201.05/202.35 kroons compared to 196.10 kroons.
The free market remained sluggish with Saku brewery
the most active with only one million kroons traded.
Saku's morning spread was higher at 36/37.50 kroons compared
to 35 kroons.
